newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin ends 5 cents up on technical buying.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin ends 5 cents up on technical buying.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended five cents higher at 13.72 ringgit ($5.44) a kg on technical buying support which emerged after a steady overnight close on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There was good buying because of the steady LME and the fact that the price has come down so much," said a tin trader in Malaysia.
Traders said the market's resistance level for next week will be 13.80 ringgit. Buyers from Europe, Japan and Malaysia took initial positions for 163 tonnes against offers of 111.
Final turnover was at 138 tonnes, against the 87 on Thursday. The local premium against London rose to $60 from $45 a tonne previously.
